g.text: Deployable / runnable units inside the system. The bash composer dispatches to 8 sub-agent processes across 2 LLM stacks.
Subprocess shims (new in scrap) + wrapped externals (browser-use)
🔵 KEPT — already in scrap/scripts/, reused unchanged
🟠 WRAPPED — existing external script, invoked as subprocess from new shim
🟣 LIBRARY — shared chassis imported by Python bodies
